name: better-writing
description: Faithful English and Russian prose with comparative edit decisions, reusable project context, Source Packs, and audited claims.

interface.longDescription: Draft, revise, and synthesise polished prose from drafts, PDFs, scans, OCR, and Source Packs while comparing keep, repair, and recast candidates and preserving facts, provenance, project terminology, uncertainty, locale, and writer voice.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn these drafts, PDFs, or Source Packs into polished prose while preserving facts, provenance, project terminology, uncertainty, exact literals, and voice.
